site_package.source: persona research 26 Nov 2026 (recommendation, not Maryam's decision)
site_package.contents: survey+report, 1 work-redesign workshop, RI&E output (response rate, action plan, OR pack), month-6 pulse
site_package.build_up: survey tier (1950/2950) + workshop 1250 + 750 assumed for month-6 pulse and RI&E output

positioning_recommended.text: RI&E-ready PSA inventory + 90-day team work-redesign cycle; provable anonymity is the foundation, not the headline
positioning_recommended.status: research recommendation; Maryam decides. CONDITIONAL (review 2026-11-26): not deliverable until a licensed working-conditions instrument (e.g. COPSOQ III short + BAT + recovery scale) is added; until then: resources check as supplementary RI&E input
positioning_recommended.inconsistency: site hero (knowledge/tech firms, psychological resources) vs plan (horeca/care/logistics, PSA + 90-day) vs consolidated file (ethical measurement layer); reviewer: pick one

channels.weak: insurers: prevention budgets mostly individual and arbodienst-gated

review_2026_11_26.source: six-expert review /tmp/review (strategy, psychometrics, legal); reviewer recommendations, NOT Maryam's decisions

sales_cycle_stress_y1.assumption: sales start Apr 2027, 9 months; base cycle ~1.5 months -> 7.5 closing months, linear

review_2026_11_26.lead_segment_recommended: multilingual logistics and staffing agencies (Rotterdam); drop horeca as lead; care later
review_2026_11_26.licences: SCS-SF free; WOLF commercial requires contacting Bakker; AAQ-II, LOT-R, AHS, GBS, SREIS, BSCS unchecked; unbudgeted. COPSOQ: commercial use free under guidelines, no fee for questionnaire itself; NC licence wording conflicts -> confirm in writing

riskiest_assumptions.H17: verifier accepts output as PSA nadere inventarisatie
riskiest_assumptions.H18: employer pays EUR 1,500 pilot despite arbodienst/sector fund

pending_business_impacts.what: Vision 'from survey to change': product unit becomes a ~6-month change cycle (state A -> state B workshop per department -> 90-day plan -> month-6 re-measure); pilot agreement now = month 1 of the cycle only, in up to 9 languages; topic workshops become supplements; core = state B workshop per department + ~4h manager course. Tech doc adds R59-R66 (round comparison + impact dashboard, pulse, state-B kit, manager course content, onboarding/exit survey, REFS, MT translations).
pending_business_impacts.why_it_matters: Changes capability and packaging (annual change-cycle subscription, per-department workshops), adds pre-month-6 build work (R59-R62, medium each) not in current cost lines, and the month-6 comparison needs aggregates kept beyond the DPA's 3-month raw-data deletion. Six MT languages still show old hero copy until Persian is final.
sections_to_check: phase timing / build effort before first month-6 re-measure
